testcase.system-out: Scenario: ellipse-19 Retain the dimensioned ellipse through Finish and Edit Sketch ✔ Given the fixture sketch contains the ellipse with annotations 8 and 4 ✔ When Finish Sketch returns to 3D Model ✔ Then the ellipse and its dimension annotations remain visible in the oblique view ✔ When the sketch is right-clicked in the browser ✔ Then Edit Sketch is available and Visibility and Dimension Visibility are checked ✔ When Edit Sketch is selected ✔ Then the editable sketch returns in Right view with the ellipse and annotations 8 and 4
